files.M6ACK.EXEC:
/* M6D Git v0/v1 fetch ACK/NAK response regression. */
address command

oid = '54BACE2202BB0C96980CDD0AAE9A752E6188D666'
oidascii = '3534424143453232303242423043393639383043444430414145394137353245'
oidascii = oidascii || '3631383844363636'

say 'M6 ACK TEST 1: NAK response'
'EXEC GITACK PARSE 4E414B0A'
if rc \= 0 then exit rc

say 'M6 ACK TEST 2: final ACK response'
payload = '41434B20' || oidascii || '0A'
'EXEC GITACK PARSE' payload
if rc \= 0 then exit rc

say 'M6 ACK TEST 3: multi_ack continue response'
payload = '41434B20' || oidascii || '20636F6E74696E75650A'
'EXEC GITACK PARSE' payload
if rc \= 0 then exit rc

say 'M6 ACK TEST 4: detailed common response'
payload = '41434B20' || oidascii || '20636F6D6D6F6E0A'
'EXEC GITACK PARSE' payload
if rc \= 0 then exit rc

say 'M6 ACK TEST 5: detailed ready response'
payload = '41434B20' || oidascii || '2072656164790A'
'EXEC GITACK PARSE' payload
if rc \= 0 then exit rc

say 'M6 ACK TEST 6: invalid ACK status is rejected'
payload = '41434B20' || oidascii || '20626F6775730A'
'EXEC GITACK PARSE' payload
if rc = 0 then do
   say 'M6ACK: invalid ACK status unexpectedly succeeded'
   exit 8
end
say 'EXPECTED FAILURE RC=' rc

say 'M6 ACK TEST 7: malformed OID is rejected'
'EXEC GITACK PARSE 41434B20313233340A'
if rc = 0 then do
   say 'M6ACK: malformed ACK unexpectedly succeeded'
   exit 8
end
say 'EXPECTED FAILURE RC=' rc

say 'M6 FETCH ACK/NAK RESPONSE TESTS PASSED'
exit 0
files.M6ADV.EXEC:
/* M6B Git ref-advertisement parser regression. */
address command

oid = '54BACE2202BB0C96980CDD0AAE9A752E6188D666'
main = '726566732F68656164732F6D61696E'
feature = '726566732F68656164732F46656174757265'
caps = '6D756C74695F61636B207468696E2D7061636B20'
caps = caps || '736964652D62616E642D36346B206F66732D64656C7461'

/* These are literal ASCII Git wire bytes.  Do not build them with C2X()
 * on CMS because C2X of a CMS text literal yields EBCDIC bytes. */
if main \= '726566732F68656164732F6D61696E' then exit 8
if feature \= '726566732F68656164732F46656174757265' then exit 8
if caps \= '6D756C74695F61636B207468696E2D7061636B20' ||,
   '736964652D62616E642D36346B206F66732D64656C7461' then exit 8

say 'M6 ADV TEST 1: parse ordinary advertised main ref'
payload = oid || '20' || main
'EXEC GITADV PARSE' payload
if rc \= 0 then exit rc

say 'M6 ADV TEST 2: parse first ref with NUL capability list'
payload = oid || '20' || main || '00' || caps
'EXEC GITADV PARSE' payload
if rc \= 0 then exit rc

say 'M6 ADV TEST 3: mixed-case ref name is preserved'
payload = oid || '20' || feature
'EXEC GITADV PARSE' payload
if rc \= 0 then exit rc

say 'M6 ADV TEST 4: short object-id is rejected'
payload = '54BACE22' || '20' || main
'EXEC GITADV PARSE' payload
if rc = 0 then do
   say 'M6ADV: short object-id unexpectedly succeeded'
   exit 8
end
say 'EXPECTED FAILURE RC=' rc

say 'M6 ADV TEST 5: missing ref name is rejected'
payload = oid || '20'
'EXEC GITADV PARSE' payload
if rc = 0 then do
   say 'M6ADV: missing ref unexpectedly succeeded'
   exit 8
end
say 'EXPECTED FAILURE RC=' rc

say 'M6 REF ADVERTISEMENT PARSER TESTS PASSED'
exit 0
